newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine deflation 0.5 pct in March - Menem.
newsitem.headline: Argentine deflation 0.5 pct in March - Menem.

text.p: Argentine consumer prices fell 0.5 percent in March, President Carlos Menem said Monday.
"Argentina has had stability for six years. Our currency is the envy of many countries," Menem said.
March deflation would compare with another 0.5-percent fall in prices in the same month last year, and inflation of 0.4 percent this February.
Argentina has reduced inflation from an annual 4,923 percent in 1989 to 0.1 percent in 1996.
